title: Museum ticket prices
hints: Go through the age groups in order, youngest first, and `return` as soon as one matches.
Use `if age <= 2:` ... `elif age <= 12:` ... `elif age <= 64:` ... `else:`. Each `elif` only runs if every check above it was `False`.
`if age <= 2: return 0`, `elif age <= 12: return 60`, `elif age <= 64: return 120`, `else: return 80`
